- A2.3 Documentation

- A3.3 Documentation

- A6.2 Tests
- A6.3 Documentation

- A7.3 Documentation

- A8.1 Implement compression options in Rabbit source and sink
- A8.2 Tests
- A8.3 Documentation

- Overall integration testing, build/CI updates, release management? Maybe keep it minimal. The task says "development of the software increment into the activities necessary to deliver it". I can include integration and verification activities.

technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is Spring XD aligned to Spring Boot 1.2.0.RELEASE / Spring Framework 4.1.3 (per U5); the general Spring Framework 6 / Java 17 text in the specification is treated as background context, not as the target of this increment.

U2: Add a 'codec' option to the hdfs-dataset sink that maps to Avro's CodecFactory; value 'none' (or null) disables the default Snappy compression, and any valid Avro codec name (e.g., deflate, bzip2) can be supplied.

U3: Extend the Mail sink with a 'java-mail-properties' attribute that references a <util:properties/> bean; the properties are wired into the underlying Spring Integration mail adapters so that imaps/smtps with SSLSocketFactory settings work without code changes to adapters themselves.

U4: Add partitionResultsTimeout to the module options metadata of the singlestep-partitioning job strategy so it is visible for all jobs that import it (including the 3 out-of-the-box jobs); regenerate/refresh the module metadata wiki page.

U5: Manage all dependency versions via the existing property-based build files, aligning them with Boot 1.2.0's dependency management; fix resulting API and behavior changes and validate via the full regression suite.

U6: Introduce an external YAML deployment-manifest file loaded at stream deployment time; manifest properties are parsed with SnakeYAML (via Boot's YAML support) and merged with/override inline deployment properties in the stream definition.

U7: Implement a pluggable compression Codec abstraction in the message bus with gzip and zip implementations for both compression (producer side) and decompression (consumer side), selectable via stream/module options.
U8: Expose compression options on the Rabbit source and sink modules that delegate to the U7 codec abstraction, keeping wire format compatible between compressed producers and consumers.
assumptions: A single developer (the author) performs all work; all figures are effort in work-hours, not elapsed calendar time.
The developer is experienced with the Spring XD codebase, Spring Integration, Spring Batch, Hadoop/HDFS, Avro, JavaMail and RabbitMQ.
Test infrastructure is already available and its procurement/setup cost is excluded: a Hadoop cluster with Sqoop and HDFS, a RabbitMQ broker, and secured (TLS) IMAP/SMTP test servers/mailboxes.
For U1, representative benchmark datasets (in the tens of GB range) and basic data-loading tooling already exist; only benchmark-specific data preparation is counted.
Documentation effort is limited to module README/wiki updates explicitly referenced by the stories; no formal product documentation overhaul is included.
No UI changes are required; all features are configuration/metadata level.
Estimates include self-verification (unit and integration testing) but exclude formal peer review, project management and release-coordination meetings.
The existing build uses version properties as listed in U5, so the upgrade is primarily a property change plus compatibility remediation.

activities.activity_name: U1: Benchmark planning and test data preparation
activities.activity_description: Define benchmark scenarios and metrics for comparing the Sqoop import job vs. the jdbchdfs batch job (dataset sizes, concurrency, throughput/latency measures); prepare and stage representative test data in HDFS/relational source.

activities.activity_name: U1: Benchmark environment configuration and execution
activities.activity_description: Configure Sqoop and jdbchdfs jobs in XD, execute repeated benchmark runs for each scenario, and capture performance statistics (timings, throughput, resource usage).

activities.activity_name: U1: Results analysis and comparison report
activities.activity_description: Aggregate and analyze collected statistics, produce comparison tables/charts and a written report contrasting Sqoop vs. jdbchdfs performance.

activities.activity_name: U2: Implement configurable compression codec for hdfs-dataset sink
activities.activity_description: Add a codec option to the hdfs-dataset sink for Avro files: allow disabling the default Snappy compression ('none') and allow specifying an alternative Avro codec, mapping the option to Avro's CodecFactory in the writer configuration.

activities.activity_name: U2: Tests for hdfs-dataset codec configuration
activities.activity_description: Unit and integration tests verifying default behavior (Snappy), disabled compression, and custom codec output (file readability and codec metadata in HDFS).

activities.activity_name: U2: Documentation for hdfs-dataset codec options
activities.activity_description: Update hdfs-dataset sink module documentation/wiki with the new codec option, allowed values and examples.

activities.activity_name: U3: Implement java-mail-properties (TLS) support in Mail sink
activities.activity_description: Add a java-mail-properties attribute to the Mail sink accepting a <util:properties/> bean reference and wire the properties into the Spring Integration mail adapters so secured imaps/smtps connections (SSLSocketFactory etc.) work.

activities.activity_name: U3: Tests against secured IMAP/SMTP servers
activities.activity_description: Integration tests against TLS-secured IMAP and SMTP servers verifying connection, authentication, send/receive paths and fallback behavior.

activities.activity_name: U3: Documentation for Mail sink TLS configuration
activities.activity_description: Document the java-mail-properties attribute with the SSL/TLS property example and link to the JavaMail property reference.

activities.activity_name: U4: Expose partitionResultsTimeout as job metadata attribute
activities.activity_description: Add partitionResultsTimeout to the module options metadata for jobs using the singlestep-partitioning strategy (including the 3 OOTB jobs that import it), verify it is surfaced, and update the metadata wiki page; includes a metadata verification test.

activities.activity_name: U5: Update build dependency versions for Boot 1.2.0 alignment
activities.activity_description: Set spring-boot to 1.2.0.RELEASE and update all ~35 listed dependency version properties (Spring 4.1.3, Spring Batch 3.0.2, Jackson 2.4.4, Tomcat 8.0.15, Jetty 9.2.4, etc.) in the build files; resolve dependency convergence issues.

activities.activity_name: U5: Resolve code incompatibilities from the upgrade
activities.activity_description: Fix compilation errors and adapt code/configuration for API and behavior changes introduced by Boot 1.2.0 and the upgraded dependencies (Spring Framework, Security, Data release train, servlet containers, etc.).

activities.activity_name: U5: Regression testing and stabilization
activities.activity_description: Run the full XD test suite and distributed runtime smoke tests, diagnose and fix regressions caused by the dependency upgrade until the build is stable.

activities.activity_name: U5: Documentation and release notes for the upgrade
activities.activity_description: Document the new baseline versions, migration notes and any behavior changes relevant to users/admins.

activities.activity_name: U6: Design and implement YML deployment manifest support
activities.activity_description: Design the external YAML deployment-manifest format; implement loading/parsing (SnakeYAML via Boot) and merge manifest properties with inline stream deployment properties at deployment time, including validation and error handling.

activities.activity_name: U6: Tests for YML deployment manifest
activities.activity_description: Unit and integration tests for manifest parsing, property merging/overrides, missing/malformed file handling and end-to-end stream deployment using a manifest file.

activities.activity_name: U6: Documentation for YML deployment manifest
activities.activity_description: Document the manifest file format, usage in stream deployment commands and examples.

activities.activity_name: U7: Implement gzip/zip message compression codecs
activities.activity_description: Implement a pluggable compression codec abstraction in the message bus with gzip and zip compressors/decompressors, plus the stream/module options to select compression for message payloads.

activities.activity_name: U7: Tests for message compression codecs
activities.activity_description: Unit tests for round-trip gzip/zip compression/decompression and integration tests verifying end-to-end compressed message flow and throughput characteristics.

activities.activity_name: U7: Documentation for message compression
activities.activity_description: Document compression options, supported codecs (gzip, zip) and performance trade-offs.

activities.activity_name: U8: Add compression options to Rabbit source and sink modules
activities.activity_description: Expose and wire compression/decompression options in the Rabbit source and sink modules, delegating to the U7 codec abstraction and ensuring wire-format compatibility between producers and consumers.

activities.activity_name: U8: Tests for Rabbit source/sink compression
activities.activity_description: Integration tests against a RabbitMQ broker covering compressed publish/consume, mixed compressed/uncompressed flows and error cases.

activities.activity_name: U8: Documentation for Rabbit compression options
activities.activity_description: Document the new compression options for the Rabbit source and sink modules with examples.

activities.activity_name: Cross-increment integration and system verification
activities.activity_description: Integrate all stories on the upgraded Boot 1.2.0 baseline, run end-to-end stream/job scenarios covering hdfs-dataset, mail, Rabbit compression and deployment manifests, and fix integration defects.

activities.activity_name: Build/CI updates and release packaging
activities.activity_description: Update CI jobs for the new dependency set, verify distribution packaging (embedded containers, module descriptors) and prepare the increment build for release.
